text:
maria: Heads up — noticed the JS SDK is logging full prompts at INFO level in the sample app. OTEL hooks also seem to miss the x-request-id so traces don't have request_id attribute. Repro steps below.
kevin: ugh, that's bad. Can you paste the log line + sample config?
maria: log line: `INFO 2026-02-20T12:34:56Z Request handled route=/generate prompt=\"Write a haiku about cats\" request_id=none`
kevin: looks like request_id never injected. Are you using the middleware we added in python? JS SDK should have equivalent.
sasha: we do have an opentelemetry hook in the JS SDK, but it's optional and only attaches span attributes if `attachRequestId=true` in config. default is false for parity reasons — hmm.
ryan: parity bug then. Python sets `x-request-id` header -> OTEL attribute automatically via the RequestMiddleware. JS probably dropped that in last refactor.
maria: sample app config I'm running:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, otel: { enabled: true } });
```
kevin: that's minimal. We expect middleware to set `x-request-id` header on outgoing requests and to add an attribute `redwood.request_id` to spans. If header absent, logs should still show a generated request id.
sasha: found the PR that changed `requestId` generation: it moved to the transport layer but forgot to expose it to the logger and otel hook. I'll open an issue.
maria: other related problem: redaction. Even with `REDACT_PROMPT=true` env, the prompt is still printed in logs at INFO (we only redact at ERROR currently). That's a customer data exposure risk.
ryan: yeah we added a `logLevel` option but sample apps set it to INFO by default. We should: 1) ensure redaction applies at all levels when opt-in 2) recommend default log level INFO but redact sensitive fields 3) add a sample-app demonstration.
kevin: small patch idea: add a LoggerFilter that runs before formatting, something like:
```js
logger.addFilter((record) => {
  if (process.env.REDACT_PROMPT === 'true') {
    record.msg = record.msg.replace(/prompt=\".*?\"/, 'prompt=\"[REDACTED]\"')
  }
  return true
})
```
kevin: also need to attach request id to the active span: `opentelemetry.trace.getSpan(context.active()).setAttribute('redwood.request_id', reqId)` at transport start.
maria: I can prototype a patch and a tiny sample app in the repo. Would prefer to show both middleware and an OTEL integration example.
sasha: please also add tests asserting that when `REDACT_PROMPT=true` logs never include raw prompts at any level. Basic regex check is fine.
dev-bot: Created issue #2345: "js-sdk: ensure request_id injected into logs and OTEL spans; redact prompts at all log levels" (<https://redwood.internal/issue/2345>) :white_check_mark:
ryan: thanks @dev-bot. maria, can you attach a small repro and tests to the issue? I'll take review.
maria: will do. I'll include a before/after sample-app and an e2e that pipes logs and ensures redact. ETA EOD tomorrow. :+1:
kevin: one more ask — update docs/devex/telemetry.md to include explicit instructions for `x-request-id`, `redwood.request_id` span attribute, and an example for `logger.addFilter`. New sample app can live under `examples/telemetry-js`.
sasha: noted. If anyone wants to pair on the OTEL hook I can help this afternoon. :eyes:
ryan: great. let's aim to ship a patch + sample next week.
